resources.string: Offline translation with on-device OCR, overlapping strips and text-mask background repair. Google Play services and initial model downloads are required. Complex textures and line art may lose detail; the original remains available.

Translation ready. Close this panel to read; reopen to compare with the original.

Google Play services are unavailable. This OCR prototype cannot run on this device.
OCR model download requested. Wait for Google Play services to finish downloading, then retry.
